items.briefing:
ASIC is warning Australians about a surge in investment scams using AI-generated deepfakes — realistic fake videos or images of trusted figures used to lure victims into fraudulent schemes. Separately, a China-linked hacking group has demonstrated advanced AI-powered attack capabilities targeting the Asia-Pacific region, meaning Australian organisations should remain alert to sophisticated intrusion attempts. OpenAI has also launched a teen-specific version of ChatGPT in Australia with added safety features, worth noting for organisations with younger staff or students.

If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — even featuring a recognisable face or voice — verify it through official channels before engaging.

featured.title: Keeper launches Microsoft Power Platform secrets connector
featured.summary: Organisations using Microsoft automation can now keep credentials out of scripts, reducing the risk of exposed secrets in cloud workflows.
